corrections.subject: final source/fixture binding
corrections.text: Add projects/chirality-piping/fixtures/product_preview/invented_mechanics_result.json as the P5-authorized generator-only tenth member. The final binding records its exact hash and generator parity whether its bytes changed or remained unchanged; if changed, it is part of the reviewed diff.

corrections.subject: review sequencing
corrections.text: Focused unit, analytical, and Playwright diagnostics may run before final freeze and review. After all corrections stop, freeze the complete ten-member source/fixture binding and changed-path diff, then perform one fresh independent review covering 100% of that final diff. Manager-local final reviews are not additionally required by this plan.

corrections.subject: publication gates
corrections.text: Fresh native witness, clean source commit, complete DEC-025 sweep, practitioner validation, and publication remain downstream of PASS on the frozen final review.

unchanged_terms: All other commands, native isolation controls, clean-sweep requirement, source-equality gate, and standing Git authority in the predecessor remain unchanged.
execution_hold: No build or Git action until the supervising root supplies the final freeze signal.
